description: This Java source file defines the CompositeCachingHealthCheckingActor class, an Akka actor responsible for aggregating health status from multiple child actors, caching the results, and scheduling periodic health checks.

classes.name: CompositeCachingHealthCheckingActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that manages health checks for multiple subsystems by aggregating their statuses, caching results, and scheduling periodic health retrieval.

classes.name: CheckHealth
classes.description: Internal immutable class representing a command to trigger health checks.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for instantiating the actor with specified child actor properties, update interval, and enabled flag.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initializes scheduled health checks if enabled when the actor starts.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Cancels scheduled health checks when the actor stops.

methods.name: matchCustomMessages
methods.description: Defines message handling for CheckHealth commands and StatusInfo updates.

methods.name: triggerHealthRetrieval
methods.description: Uses cached status to update health without querying subsystems.

methods.name: inverseMap
methods.description: Utility method to invert a map from keys to values into a map from values to keys.

methods.name: getAggregatedStatus
methods.description: Constructs a composite StatusInfo from current child statuses.

methods.name: applyChildStatus
methods.description: Updates the cached status for a child actor based on received StatusInfo.

methods.name: pollHealth
methods.description: Triggers health retrieval from all child actors.
